narrative.overview: The portfolio reads like a well-typeset test report: warm paper, white sheets laid on it, a serif voice for names and page titles, and a single teal accent that marks what is navigable or verified. Evidence leads; the interface steps back. Sober, editorial, trustworthy: credibility comes from clarity and restraint, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper (paper) with pure white sheets on top.
Serif display for names and page titles, sans for everything else.
One accent (teal-ink) carries links, active nav, labels and bullets.
Flat by default; one hairline shadow on cards.
Uppercase, letter-spaced micro-labels introduce each section.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only chromatic color. It marks interaction and verification; it is never used as a surface fill beyond its 10% wash.

rules.name: The AA Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text color holds at least 4.5:1 on both Paper and Sheet White. Secondary text never goes lighter than Faint Stone (#6b6a65).

rules.name: The Serif Is a Name Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is for the person's name and page titles only. Section titles, UI and data stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Only floating menus get a real lift; hover changes color, not elevation.

dos: Do keep teal (#01696f) as the only chromatic color, on interaction and verification.
Do separate sections with 1px Hairline rules and 56px padding rather than boxes.
Do introduce each section with the uppercase 0.75rem teal label.
Do put new text in web/src/i18n/translations.ts; es and en stay equal.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus state and full keyboard operation (WCAG AA).
Do draw colors from the CSS variables in web/src/css/tokens.css.
donts: Don't introduce text lighter than Faint Stone (#6b6a65).
Don't add gradients, glass or colored shadows to UI chrome, and never a second accent color. The one exception is the QA Playground shop art gradients.
Don't use Instrument Serif for UI, data or section titles.
Don't raise cards on hover; change color, not elevation.
Don't hardcode hex values in components.
